meta.aiUse: Built by pipeline code written with AI assistance (Claude Code), directed and reviewed by the team. See AI_USE.md.

grid.order: north to south, then west to east

factors.label: Slope
factors.source: MGS MOLA Mission Experiment Gridded Data Record, 128 pixels per degree, as the USGS Astrogeology global mosaic Mars_MGS_MOLA_DEM_mosaic_global_463m (NASA PDS; Smith et al. 2001)
factors.note: 55.6 km square window centred on the cell centre, posts of 463 m (MOLA 128 pixels per degree), pipeline/terrain_metrics.py: the method used for the targets and for Earth. Towards the poles neighbouring windows overlap.

factors.label: Roughness
factors.source: MGS MOLA Mission Experiment Gridded Data Record, 128 pixels per degree, as the USGS Astrogeology global mosaic Mars_MGS_MOLA_DEM_mosaic_global_463m (NASA PDS; Smith et al. 2001)
factors.note: 55.6 km square window centred on the cell centre, posts of 463 m (MOLA 128 pixels per degree), pipeline/terrain_metrics.py: the method used for the targets and for Earth. Towards the poles neighbouring windows overlap.

factors.label: Mean air temperature at 2 m
factors.source: Mars Climate Database v6.2 (LMD / OU / IAA / ESA / CNES), climatology scenario with average solar forcing, maps on the database grid of about 3.8 by 5.6 degrees
factors.note: A climate model, not a measurement. Each cell takes the nearest map node; nothing is interpolated. Season-weighted mean of 12 diurnal-mean maps (every 30 degrees of solar longitude). Same quantity and source as the Mars targets.

factors.label: Day-night air temperature range at 2 m
factors.source: Mars Climate Database v6.2 (LMD / OU / IAA / ESA / CNES), climatology scenario with average solar forcing, maps on the database grid of about 3.8 by 5.6 degrees
factors.note: A climate model, not a measurement. Each cell takes the nearest map node; nothing is interpolated. Highest minus lowest of 8 local times (every 3 hours), mean of 4 seasons. A lower bound: 3-hour steps can miss the peak and the trough.

factors.label: Mean surface temperature
factors.source: Mars Climate Database v6.2 (LMD / OU / IAA / ESA / CNES), climatology scenario with average solar forcing, maps on the database grid of about 3.8 by 5.6 degrees
factors.note: A climate model, not a measurement. Each cell takes the nearest map node; nothing is interpolated. As tempMean, for the ground surface. Not used by the score.

factors.label: Rock class
factors.source: Geologic Map of Mars, 1:20,000,000 (Tanaka et al. 2014, USGS Scientific Investigations Map 3292), layer SIM3292_Global_Geology
factors.note: GLiM class codes as in earth.json, assigned from the map unit by the table in unitTable. The class with the largest area in the cell, if classed units cover at least 50% of it. Volcanic units are class 2 (basaltic) by the project's reading; highland, lowland and transition units have no class.

unitTable.description: Amazonian and Hesperian transition undivided unit
Hesperian and Noachian highland undivided unit

factors.label: Water in the top metre of ground
factors.source: 2001 Mars Odyssey Gamma Ray Spectrometer, element concentration maps, H2O, smoothed 5 degree bins (NASA PDS, ODY-M-GRS-5-ELEMENTS-V1.0, product H2O_SR_5X5)
factors.note: Water-equivalent hydrogen as weight percent H2O, sensed to a few tens of centimetres. Each cell takes its 5 degree bin. Null poleward of the map's limit. This is not the SWIM ice map: the SWIM site could not be reached when this file was built.

factors.label: Wind speed at 10 m
factors.source: Mars Climate Database v6.2 (LMD / OU / IAA / ESA / CNES), climatology scenario with average solar forcing, maps on the database grid of about 3.8 by 5.6 degrees
factors.note: A climate model, not a measurement. Each cell takes the nearest map node; nothing is interpolated. Horizontal wind speed 10 m above the surface, season-weighted mean of 12 diurnal-mean maps. Same height as Earth's windSpeed.

factors.label: Dust optical depth of the air column (visible light)
factors.source: Mars Climate Database v6.2 (LMD / OU / IAA / ESA / CNES), climatology scenario with average solar forcing, maps on the database grid of about 3.8 by 5.6 degrees
factors.note: A climate model, not a measurement. Each cell takes the nearest map node; nothing is interpolated. Monthly mean dust column visible optical depth, season-weighted mean of 12 maps. Compare with Earth's aod, which counts all aerosol, not dust alone.

notInFile.precip: No rain; see the target notes in targets.json for the literature value.
notInFile.swimIce: The SWIM subsurface ice maps were asked for but swim.psi.edu returned HTTP 523 on 2026-11-15; waterH2O is given instead.
